messages:
deploybot: Auto-pinned runtime v3.4.0 -> model-group 'multigen-lite' after canary failed 0.6% errors. Pin applied at 10:03 UTC to canary pools only. Logs: /deploy/logs/1822222222.

danielle: quick ask - is this a binding mismatch or a kernel crash?

jamal: binding mismatch. SDK 4.2 added optional field `meta_flags`; runtime v3.4.0's quant kernels treat unknown fields as fatal. Repro minimal: `curl -X POST /internal/test -d '{"meta_flags":1}'` => kernel_reject.

ops: ops note: we prevented global auto-escalation. Pin TTL default 6h. Recommend a hotpatch to runtime to ignore unknown fields for quant kernels.

devex: if we hotpatch, we need a short customer note and a self-host SDK workaround. I can draft and push to #product-comm.

sla-bot: Alerting thresholds set: errors >0.8% (5m) OR p95 delta >250ms (10m) -> page oncall.

danielle: plan: 1) hotpatch runtime on canary tonight 22:30 UTC, 2) monitor 30m, 3) if stable widen pin removal manually, 4) if thresholds breach run RB-19 to revert to v3.3.7. Owners: jamal->hotpatch, ops->canary monitor, devex->customer blurb.

jamal: hotpatch PR 8451 ready, needs kernel reload on quant hosts. I'll push during window.

ops: noted. I'll set the maintenance window and ensure RB-19 runbook is primed.

danielle: thanks all. keeping thread open for postmortem. deploybot: keep TTL 6h and block auto-global until manual approval.

deploybot: TTL locked to 6h. Auto-global escalation disabled.
